compilers.description: Compilers to use, in order of preference. The first one is the default; the others can be chosen with 'Asm Lens: Select Compiler' or the status bar.

oneOf.description: Compiler Explorer compiler id, e.g. g152.

id.description: Compiler Explorer compiler id, e.g. g152. Use 'Asm Lens: Select Compiler' > Browse to look ids up.

name.description: Label shown in the status bar and CodeLens.

flags.description: Flags for this compiler (overrides the top-level flags).

language.description: Only offer this compiler for C or C++ files. Omit for both.

flags.description: Default compiler flags, used by compilers without their own flags.

language.description: Force the language sent to Compiler Explorer. By default C files use C and everything else C++.

includePaths.description: Folders searched for #include files, in order of priority: the first entry is searched first, then the second, and so on. Relative paths are relative to the folder holding this file.

recursive.description: Also search every subfolder of this folder (at this priority).

buildFolders.description: Folder names searched last for headers that are found nowhere else (for generated headers). Wildcards such as cmake-build-* work.

maxIncludeFiles.description: Maximum number of header files uploaded per analysis.
